# SafeWrite

> SafeWrite is an all-in-one AI humanizer and detector platform that transforms AI-generated text into human-like content while detecting AI-written text with 99% accuracy.

SafeWrite integrates multiple leading AI detection tools (GPTZero, ZeroGPT, Turnitin, Copyleaks, Originality.ai) and provides personalized AI humanization for academic and professional writing. The platform supports 10+ languages and offers flexible pricing plans with significant discounts.
